children: Fiscal Q2 2027 net revenue of $29.1 million, Adjusted EBITDA* of $5.1 million, operating income of $2.4 million, and net income of $0.8 million - all quarterly records since fiscal Q4 2025, demonstrating significant year-over-year growth
Product-level net revenue* from GRAFAPEX™ (treosulfan) for Injection of $5.7 million also a quarterly record
Management to host conference call at 8:00 AM Eastern Time on Thursday, November 12, 2026
Toronto, Ontario and Chicago, Illinois--(Newsfile Corp. - November 11, 2026) - Medexus Pharmaceuticals

(OTCQX: MEDXF) today announced its operating and financial results and provided a business update for the company's second fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026 (the Company's fiscal Q2 2027). All dollar amounts in this news release are in US dollars unless specified otherwise.

Medexus is focused on delivering strong performance from GRAFAPEX, and also remains focused on supporting stable overall performance across the Company's portfolio of products. The Company's key financial measures of net revenue, Adjusted EBITDA*, operating income, and net income for fiscal Q2 2027 are all quarterly records since fiscal Q4 2025, the fiscal quarter in which Medexus executed the commercial launch of GRAFAPEX.

"We are pleased with the product-level performance of GRAFAPEX to date and the progress we are making in establishing its position in the allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation field, or allo-HSCT, in the United States," commented Ken d'Entremont, Chief Executive Officer of Medexus. "GRAFAPEX continues to perform in line with our expectations that product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX will be $30 million to $32 million for fiscal year 2027, considering expected adoption and repeat order patterns."

Mr. d'Entremont continued: "We also expect to see the results of recent enhancements to our commercialization strategy, including the deployment of additional field force resources starting in fiscal Q2 2027. This increased investment in new roles will address specific customer barriers in large institutions. Our people are now even more focused on increasing awareness of GRAFAPEX, strengthening engagement with transplant centers, and building on the continued adoption of the product by customers or by key institutions. We are encouraged by the early indicators we have seen and believe our expanded commercial presence positions us well to build momentum through the remainder of the fiscal year."

Medexus has continued to see a positive market response to GRAFAPEX™ (treosulfan) for Injection since the US commercial launch of the product in February 2025. The Company expects that GRAFAPEX will account for a significant portion of total net revenue and operating cash flow over the coming fiscal years. For the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, Medexus recognized product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX of $5.7 million and $10.6 million, relative to $3.8 million and $7.0 million of GRAFAPEX personnel and infrastructure investments and $0.7 million and $1.3 million of cost of sales of products (before amortization). Medexus continues to expect to achieve annual product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX of approximately $100 million to $175 million within five years after commercial launch.
Key financial highlights for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026 include the following:

Net revenue of $29.1 million and $57.7 million for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $4.4 million and $8.3 million, or 17.6% and 16.9%, compared to $24.7 million and $49.4 million for the corresponding prior year periods. The $4.4 million and $8.3 million year-over-year net revenue increase was primarily due to an increase in product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX (due to commercial traction observed to date) and IXINITY (largely due to patient demand dynamics outside the normal course) and the continued positive effects on product-level net revenue from Rasuvo of changes in the treatment landscape. The year-over-year increase for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026 was partially offset by the one-time positive impact of royalty revenue in fiscal Q1 2026.

Adjusted EBITDA* of $5.1 million and $9.8 million for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $0.7 million and $2.0 million, or 16.7% and 25.2%, compared to $4.4 million and $7.8 million for the corresponding prior year periods. The $0.7 million and $2.0 million year-over-year Adjusted EBITDA* increase was primarily due to the $5.7 million and $10.6 million of product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026 exceeding the $3.8 million and $7.0 million of GRAFAPEX personnel and infrastructure investments plus $0.7 million and $1.3 million of cost of sales of products (before amortization) in the same periods, together with the year-over-year increase in product-level net revenue from IXINITY in the six-month period ended September 30, 2026, partially offset for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026 by the one-time positive impact of royalty revenue in fiscal Q1 2026. The year-over-year increases were partially offset by the impact of generic competition on product-level net revenue from Rupall.

Operating income of $2.4 million and $4.6 million for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $1.1 million and $2.3 million, or 77.2% and 104.5%, compared to $1.4 million and $2.2 million for the corresponding prior year periods. The $1.1 million and $2.3 million year-over-year increase was primarily due to the increasing operating leverage observed in product-level performance of GRAFAPEX.

Gross margin of 55.9% and 55.8% and Adjusted Gross Margin* of 64.0% and 63.9% for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, compared to gross margin of 55.7% and 55.8% and Adjusted Gross Margin* of 65.2% and 65.4% for the corresponding prior year periods. The year-over-year changes in gross margin and Adjusted Gross Margin* are primarily due to the changes in the relative contribution of product-level net revenue reflected in net revenue discussed above, in particular an increasing level of net sales of GRAFAPEX, the one-time positive impact of the royalty revenue in fiscal Q1 2026 (for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026), and higher cost of sales of products for IXINITY in fiscal year 2027.

Net income of $0.8 million and $1.4 million for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $1.1 million and $1.2 million compared to net loss of $0.3 million and net income of $0.2 million for the corresponding prior year periods.

Available liquidity of $8.4 million (September 30, 2026), consisting of cash and cash equivalents of $8.4 million (March 31, 2026 - $6.5 million) and available credit of nil under the revolving facility of the Company's senior secured credit agreement with National Bank of Canada (March 31, 2026 - $2.5 million).

Cash provided by operating activities of $5.4 million and $4.7 million for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $2.1 million and a decrease of $2.6 million compared to $3.3 million and $7.3 million for the corresponding prior year periods, primarily due to changes in net income adjusted for non-cash items, together with year-over-year increases in income taxes paid, among other factors. Although working capital items can affect cash flow results for individual quarters, Medexus continues to expect that an increasing level of product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX will have a positive effect on operating cash flow.

* Refer to "Non-GAAP measures" at the end of this news release for information about non-GAAP measures and related items, including Adjusted EBITDA, Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted Gross Margin.

"We continue to see the remainder of fiscal year 2027 as an opportunity to demonstrate the Company's financial strength," commented Brendon Buschman, Chief Financial Officer of Medexus. "Supported by Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA* of 0.97x as of September 30, 2026, we expect to continue generating meaningful operating cash flow in fiscal year 2027, in particular as GRAFAPEX continues to scale."

Mr. d'Entremont concluded: "We are pleased with the first half of fiscal year 2027, supported by the continued growth of GRAFAPEX, continued preregistration work on UM171 Cell Therapy in Canada, and a strong financial foundation. We remain focused on disciplined operational execution focused on GRAFAPEX, while our existing credit facilities and liquidity position will provide the financial flexibility to support our growth strategy and investments in business opportunities that will create long-term value."

Medexus achieved $5.7 million and $10.6 million of product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026. Underlying patient demand (determined based on units delivered by the wholesaler to institutions during the period, with reference to Medexus's corresponding product-level net revenue) was $5.6 million for fiscal Q2 2027, representing underlying patient demand growth of 16% compared to $4.8 million for fiscal Q1 2027 and 156% compared to $2.1 million for fiscal Q2 2026. (Source: Internal EDI data.) Since launch, total wholesaler purchases of GRAFAPEX have exceeded total demand by $1.4 million, resulting in an estimated one month of inventory on hand at September 30, 2026 held by the Company's single wholesaler for GRAFAPEX. This wholesaler inventory level is consistent with Medexus's expectations for this stage of a product launch; however, inventory management decisions by the wholesaler could affect the timing, volume, and commercial terms of wholesaler orders, and consequently product-level net revenue, in future quarters. Medexus expects that product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX for fiscal year 2027 will be between $30 million and $32 million. Medexus bases its expectations regarding the necessary acceleration of product-level net revenue over the remainder of fiscal year 2027 on expected adoption and repeat order patterns, in part based on enhancements to the Company's commercialization strategy, including the deployment of additional field force resources starting in fiscal Q2 2027. Medexus now expects that the annual product-level Adjusted Gross Margin* of GRAFAPEX will ultimately be approximately 85%, reflecting higher reimbursement, lower commercial and government rebates, and different tariff dynamics for the product than originally estimated. Changes in these factors over time will also have a slight effect on net revenue. Product-level Adjusted Gross Margin* for the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026 remained higher due to the evolving reimbursement dynamics for the product, in light of lower estimated outpatient utilization to date. The Company continues to evaluate product development and other lifecycle management opportunities intended to enhance the long-term commercial potential of GRAFAPEX and support the durability of its contribution to Medexus's portfolio and to allo-HSCT in the United States. The success of these initiatives could improve ease of use and/or support adoption across a broader range of transplant settings and potentially extend the product's long-term net revenue and cash flow contributions.

Patient unit demand in the United States increased by 12% over the trailing 12-month period ended September 30, 2026. (Source: customer-reported dispensing data.) Despite this recent period-over-period increase, Medexus expects that 12-month trailing unit demand will remain relatively stable in the near term as the Company works to maintain a patient base who are stable and satisfied with the product. In fiscal Q3 2026, in an effort to further improve batch yield and manufacturing costs, Medexus entered into an agreement with the Company's third-party contract manufacturer of IXINITY for a $4.0 million manufacturing process upgrade (plus $2.0 million for a test batch of IXINITY that will, if successful, be saleable product), of which approximately $1.4 million was paid in fiscal year 2026; no amounts have been paid in fiscal year 2027 to date.

In June 2026, Medexus secured exclusive Canadian rights to commercialize UM171 Cell Therapy, a proprietary advanced clinical stage investigational drug product that recently received conditional marketing authorization in Europe from the European Commission (or EC) as Zemcelpro® (dorocubicel), in a license and supply deal with ExCellThera, a blood stem cell expansion and metabolic fitness company, and Cordex Biologics, its wholly owned subsidiary. Zemcelpro is a novel personalized cryopreserved hematopoietic stem cell transplantation product containing two components, namely UM171-expanded CD34+ cells (dorocubicel) and unexpanded CD34- cells, each derived from the same cord blood unit. The product is used to treat hematological malignancies (blood cancers), such as leukemias and myelodysplasias. Cordex will manage an international multi-center phase 3 clinical trial of the product in patients with high- and very high-risk acute leukemias and myelodysplasias, which is a post-authorization measure for the product's conditional marketing authorization in Europe. Medexus has agreed to sponsor the new drug submission seeking Health Canada approval of UM171 Cell Therapy in Canada as Zemcelpro® (dorocubicel), and preliminary work on this regulatory process is underway. Given its current stage of development in Canada, Medexus does not expect to begin commercializing the product before calendar year 2028 or, depending on available regulatory pathways, possibly calendar year 2031.

Patient unit demand for Rasuvo increased by 15% over the trailing 12-month period ended September 30, 2026. (Source: Internal EDI Data.) In July 2026, Medexus and medac filed a patent infringement lawsuit in respect of a proposed generic version of Rasuvo, which remains ongoing as of the date of this news release.

Patient unit demand for Metoject decreased by 3% over the trailing 12-month period ended September 30, 2026. (Source: IQVIA - TSA Monthly Data.) Medexus attributes this decrease in unit demand to the continued effects of generic competition.

Rupall's market exclusivity, granted by Health Canada, expired in January 2025 and Rupall now faces generic competition in Canada. As a result, patient unit demand over the three- and six-month periods ended September 30, 2026 has decreased 25.7% and 27.4% when compared to the corresponding prior year periods. (Source: IQVIA TSA Monthly Data.)
